messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#define maxn 111111
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
typedef float f;
typedef long double ld;
ll i,n,x,y;

ll gcd(int x,int y){
 int p = x % y;
 x = y;
 y = p;
if(y > 0)x = gcd(x,y);
return x;
}

ll lcm(int x,int y){
return ll(x) * ll(y) / gcd(x,y);
}

ld func(int x1,int y1,int x2,int y2){
ll s = lcm(y1,y2);
ll s1 = abs(s / y1 * x1 - s / y2 * x2);
return ld(s1) / ld(s);
}

int main(){
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE 
 freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
 freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
#endif
cin >> x >> y >> n;
ll a = 0,b = 1; 
ld t1 = ld(x) / ld(y),h = 0;
  for(i=1;i<=n;i++){
   ll l = 1,r = 1000000,ave;
   while(r - l > 1){
    ave = (l + r) / 2;
	ld t2 = ld(ave) / ld(i);
    if(t2 < t1)l = ave;
	else r = ave;
   }
   ave = l;
   if((func(l,i,x,y) > func(r,i,x,y)))ave = r;
   if(func(ave,i,x,y)  < func(a,b,x,y)){
    a = ave;
	b = i;
   }
  }
cout << a << "/" << b;
return 0;
}
